name: Gorilla Technology Group Inc.
blurb: Gorilla Technology Group is a software company listed on the Nasdaq Capital Market (NasdaqCM) focused on AI infrastructure and intelligent video analytics. The company develops edge AI solutions and AI-driven surveillance and security platforms, serving enterprise and government clients across Asia and beyond. It has pursued an expansion strategy through strategic partnerships and minority investments in complementary AI infrastructure companies. Its business model combines software licensing with deployment partnerships in key growth markets.
recent: In early May 2026, Gorilla Technology drew renewed investor attention after announcing an expanded AI infrastructure collaboration in India with Yotta Data Services and increasing its investment in real-time infrastructure intelligence company Astrikos.AI. These announcements drove sharp short-term price momentum, with the stock gaining approximately 6% in a single session and roughly 38% over the prior 30 days as of May 4, 2026.
